description: Removes the personal data of a PDF or an image for good and draws black boxes in its place, then saves the result as "<name> (redacted)" with its certificate. This cannot be restored. The file is sent to Redactic in the EU and deleted there once the result is saved. The original file is not changed.

blackout_images.description: Also black out every embedded picture, such as photos, signatures and logos.

detection_mode.description: How thoroughly the text is read. "accurate" (default) takes a second look at places, addresses and organisations. "fast" skips it and answers sooner.

language.description: Language of the text as a two-letter code, as a hint.

path.description: Full path of the PDF or image.

regions.description: Countries of the document as ISO codes, for example ["IT","DE"]. Leave out to detect the country.

types.description: Entity types to mask, for example ["PERSON","IBAN"]. Leave out for all types.

name: redact_file
title: Black out a file
